BrochureContent.Content:
DNG Brady are pleased to introduce this attractive detached family home, ideally located within the established and highly desirable Stameen development, just off the Dublin Road. Extending to approximately 145 sq.m (1,560 sq.ft), this spacious property offers comfortable family living in a prime residential setting.

The location is second to none, with the town centre just a short distance away and a wide selection of amenities nearby, including schools, shops, restaurants, and recreational facilities. Excellent transport links are also on hand, with the train station approximately 10 minutes away, a main bus route within a 2-minute walk, and convenient access to the M1 motorway for commuters.

The bright and well-proportioned accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, sitting room, kitchen, dining room, utility room, guest WC, living room, four bedrooms, and a family bathroom. One of the bedrooms benefits from direct access to a private balcony area, complete with outdoor seating, providing the perfect spot to relax and enjoy the surroundings.

Outside, the property features a driveway and garden to the front, while the rear boasts beautifully landscaped gardens offering privacy and an ideal space for outdoor entertaining and family enjoyment.

Offering an excellent opportunity to secure a quality family home in a sought-after location, this property is sure to appeal to a wide range of buyers. Early viewing is highly recommended.
